claims.statement: Tom Allen was behind Ed Smith in his corner during the fight with Joe Goddard at New Orleans.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, the veteran ex-champion, who was behind Smith, says that the fight was fairly won

claims.statement: Tom Allen had picked Ed Smith to beat Joe Goddard before the fight.
claims.excerpt: because he Knew that the man was cleverand had a great right and felt that Goddard could be defeated

claims.statement: Tom Allen told Ed Smith to get his head into Joe Goddard's body if he could and to stick close all the time.
claims.excerpt: He told Smith to get his head into Goddard’s body if he could and to stick close allthe time

claims.statement: Tom Allen said Ed Smith fairly won the fight with Joe Goddard.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, the veteran ex-champion, who was behind Smith, says that the fight was fairly won

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: There was no use fn stand-off and exchanging blows withthe giant and there is no law to make a man fight Goddard that way.
